text: The cracked solder joint at J2 opened up after fitting the lock.

The solder fillet is visibly fractured around a connector pin; the cable is intact.
I found a crushed inner tray beside the undamaged carton wall.
The crushed liner left the retaining clip loose against the black trim.
The crushed foam insert flattened at the handle. The shipping label was intact.

A collapsed insert let the rotor migrate while the box remained square.
The protective molded cradle inside the box had buckled flat where the latch was held.
Below zero, the fingerprint reader rejected my registered thumb twice.
After a freezing night the fingerprint sensor needs three retries before it unlocks.
The fingerprint sensor failed in subzero weather; the same finger worked after warming.

At −8 °C the biometric pad asks me to try three times. It is fine indoors.

面板没被碰也会自动唤醒，电量掉得比正常快。
The keyboard backlight turns on repeatedly while the panel is untouched.

The carrier marked damaged on the handoff note; the package corner was folded inward.
外箱穿孔对应面板贯穿划痕，签收时已拍照。

The oversized mounting pin won't enter the incoming fit gauge.
螺柱孔径来料超差，和合格套件的实测差值已记录。
It won't pair with a second phone after a clean reset.
插入新电池仍然无法开机，但接触端子外观正常。
The unit repeatedly shuts down after I update the settings.

No crushed inner tray. I returned it over the price.
No sign of a visible problem. I simply ordered the wrong color.
The fingerprint reader worked first time in freezing weather. One star for payment support.

未见物流撞击，差评是因为安装预约慢。
Do not confuse cold solder with intermittent symptoms. I have no physical evidence here.
